qe: The 'Chief Information Commissioner' (CIC) and Information Commissioners are appointed for how many years?
o: As prescribed by Central Govt (केंद्र सरकार द्वारा निर्धारित)
e: 1. Technical Point: 2019 ke amendment ke baad term fix nahi hai, sarkar tay karti hai (Zyadatar 3 saal). \n2. Max Age: 65 saal ki age tak hi reh sakte hain.

qe: Who is the Chairman of the 'Kendriya Hindi Samiti'?
e: 1. Logic: Hindi promotion ke liye ye apex body hai jiska head hamesha PM hota hai.

qe: Which body oversees the implementation of the 'Sustainable Development Goals' (SDGs) in India?
e: 1. Status: NITI Aayog 'SDG India Index' nikalta hai jisme states ki ranking hoti hai.

qe: The 'National Commission for Women' (NCW) consists of a Chairperson and how many members?
e: 1. Structure: 1 Chairperson + 5 Members. \n2. Condition: Inme se kam se kam 1 member SC aur 1 ST community se hona zaroori hai.

qe: Who regulates the 'Banking' sector in India?
e: 1. Status: RBI Act 1934 se bana Statutory body. \n2. Note: Halanki ye non-constitutional hai, par ye desh ka Central Bank hai.

qe: The 'Lokayukta' in many states is a retired judge. Is it mandatory in Bihar?
e: 1. Logic: Judicial background jaanch ke liye zaroori hai.

qe: Which body advises the President on the 'Appointment' of the CVC?
e: 1. Committee: PM, Home Minister aur Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha.

qe: The 'National Law Commission' is which type of body?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Ye har 3 saal mein naya banta hai, isliye ye ad-hoc (temporary) executive body hai.

qe: The 'Information Commissioner' term is fixed by?
e: 1. Change: 2019 ke amendment ke baad Central Govt tay karti hai (Pehle ye 5 saal fix tha).

qe: Which body manages 'Elections' to Co-operative societies in Bihar?
o: Bihar State Election Authority (बिहार राज्य निर्वाचन प्राधिकार)
e: 1. Fact: Bihar mein co-operative societies ke liye alag se body hai.

qe: Is the 'Lokayukta' verdict binding on the Bihar Government?
o: No, it is recommendatory (नहीं, यह केवल सिफारिशी है)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Ombudsman bodies zyadatar advisory hoti hain, asli action Govt leti hai.
